nodes.description: MSX2 and ALX4 are expressed in the ectomeninx, the mesenchyme that gives rise to both the calvarial bones and the dura. Reduced dosage is proposed to disturb dural and falcine patterning in parallel with the bone defect, giving persistent embryonic falcine venous channels, straight sinus hypoplasia, and high tentorial insertion. This node is inferred from the co-occurrence of the dural and skull findings and has not been tested directly.
